summary: This tutorial covers various view options in LibreOffice Impress, including Normal View, Outline View, Slide Sorter, and Notes View. It explains how to switch between these views and customize slide designs using the Master Pages feature. Normal View shows slides in a default layout, while Outline View organizes slides hierarchically. Slide Sorter allows reordering slides, and Notes View lets you add notes for each slide. The tutorial also demonstrates changing the layout of individual slides using the Layout Section feature. Key takeaways include using the Master Pages to apply consistent design elements across all slides and adjusting the slide layout to fit specific needs. The tutorial concludes with instructions on creating a new presentation with a dark blue background and light blue title areas, utilizing the Master Pages feature.
